mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is active during monetary easing cycles regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% signals labor market weakness, triggering monetary policy easing and boosting equity returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly GDP contraction (GDPC1 growth < 0%) and monthly industrial production decline (INDPRO growth < 0%) signal imminent economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate < 0% and INDPRO growth rate < 0%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and INDPRO growth rates are negative.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (annual CPIAUCSL inflation > 2%) prompt aggressive monetary tightening, depressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL annual inflation rate exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly payroll growth exceeding 0.5% indicates robust labor market conditions, driving immediate positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days through elevated consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth rate exceeds 0.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 800,000 units signal weak consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 800.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous retail sales decline (RSAFS growth < 0%) and unemployment rate above 7.0% indicate deteriorating economic conditions, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days through dual demand and labor market weakness.
regime_hint: dual weakness in retail and labor
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS growth rate < 0% and UNRATE > 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production contraction (INDPRO growth < 0%) during supply shock regimes reduces manufacturing output and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth rate < 0%.
